objective: same predeclared relative-energy/0.05 and Cartesian-force/0.5 objective; same +/-1000 bounds; no regularization
resampling: keep original training energy anchor and resample remaining17 blocks with replacement; duplicates are weights, not duplicate reference calculations
scope: within-control statistical sensitivity only, no methyl-PDMS transfer
uncertainty_criteria: All claimed coefficients require bootstrap sigma/abs(value)<=0.5, no active bound, and at least90 valid replicates. Method/basis reference uncertainty is separate.
unit: whole training geometry/conformer energy-and-full-force block, not individual force components
